scienceEn: Paper makes a signal. AI finds a pattern.
scienceKo: 한지가 만든 신호에서 AI가 패턴을 찾습니다.
paperTitle: Effects of the properties of mulberry paper on high-performance triboelectric nanogenerators towards AI-based self-powered healthcare applications
noteEn: A study of sensor signals and foot health classification.
noteKo: 센서 신호로 발의 건강 상태를 분류한 연구입니다.
captions: Contact and separation create an electrical signal.
Machine learning analyzes patterns in those signals.
The study explored classification of foot health conditions.
연구에서는 발의 건강 상태 분류를 탐구했습니다.

scienceEn: Graphite. Graphene. A clue in DNA.
paperTitle: Portable, Wireless Potentiostat Sensor for Ultra-Sensitive, Real-Time Detection of 5hmC in Genomic DNA Using Tree-Like Graphene
noteEn: Detecting a DNA marker with a portable wireless sensor.
noteKo: 휴대형 무선 센서로 DNA 표지를 검출한 연구입니다.
captions: This pencil wants a new job.
Pencil graphite is a source of tree-like graphene.
연필 흑연으로 나뭇가지 형태의 그래핀을 만듭니다.
The graphene helps an electrode detect 5hmC in DNA.
Measurements travel wirelessly to a mobile app.

paperTitle: Recent advancements in carbon-based materials for resistive switching applications
noteEn: A review of carbon materials for resistive-switching memory.
noteKo: 탄소 기반 저항변화 메모리의 연구 동향을 정리한 리뷰입니다.
captions: Like traffic, current flows more easily when resistance is lower.
길이 뚫리듯, 저항이 낮아지면 전류도 쉽게 흐릅니다.
Different resistance states can represent stored information.
서로 다른 저항 상태에 정보를 저장할 수 있습니다.
This review explores carbon materials for that memory.
이 리뷰는 탄소 소재를 이용한 메모리 연구를 소개합니다.

titleEn: NO OXYGEN ON THE GUEST LIST
scienceEn: A little protection goes a long way.
paperTitle: Oxygen-scavenging MnO₂ nanoparticles enabled thermally stable and oxidation-resistant MXene inks for 3D-printed flexible asymmetric supercapacitors
noteEn: MnO₂ helps protect MXene ink from oxidation.
noteKo: MnO₂가 MXene 잉크의 산화를 줄이는 데 도움을 줍니다.
captions: Sorry. Oxygen is not on the list.
MXene is useful for printed energy storage.
MXene은 인쇄형 에너지 저장에 유용한 소재입니다.
MnO₂ nanoparticles help reduce its oxidation.
The ink becomes a printed flexible supercapacitor.

scienceEn: A touch becomes an electrical signal.
paperTitle: Self-powered gesture recognition using a sustainable and thermally stable cherry blossom triboelectric nanogenerator
noteEn: Touch signals classified with machine learning.
noteKo: 터치로 생긴 신호를 머신러닝으로 분류한 연구입니다.
captions: It was supposed to be cleaning time.
One tap. Two taps. A new obsession.
한 번, 두 번. 새로운 취미가 생겼다.
Cherry petals form a layer inside the fabricated device.
제작한 소자 안에 벚꽃잎을 재료로 사용합니다.
Contact and separation create electrical signals.
Machine learning distinguishes single and double taps.
